import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { Given, Then, When } from '@cucumber/cucumber';

Given('a fresh account store', function () {
  this.accounts = new Set<string>();
  if (process.env.BDD_CORPUS_DEFECT === '1') this.accounts.add('unexpected');
});
When('I create account A', function () {
  if (process.env.BDD_CORPUS_DEFECT !== '1') this.accounts.add('A');
});
Then('this store contains account A', function () {
  assert.equal(this.accounts.has('A'), true);
});
Then('this store contains {int} accounts', function (count: number) {
  assert.equal(this.accounts.size, count);
});
